# Security Policy

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| 1.0.x   | yes       |
| 0.6.x   | security fixes only |
| < 0.6   | no        |

## Reporting

Portsmith reads local capture files and opens local listening sockets only -
no outbound telemetry. If you find a vulnerability (for example a
path-traversal in trace file handling or an unsafe decode path), open a
private security advisory rather than a public issue. Expect a first response
within 7 days.
